learning_outcomes.text: Describe the main renewable technologies and their resource basis
Assess sites, resources and energy yield at a screening level
Navigate permitting, grid connection and stakeholder requirements
Build a basic project financial model and understand PPAs
Outline project delivery, risks and the development-to-operation path

integrative_case: A developer screens a site for a solar project. Estimate the resource and yield, build a permitting and grid-connection checklist with the real constraints, assemble a simplified LCOE and compare a PPA against merchant revenue, and lay out the stage-gated path to operation with the main risks at each gate.
